prompts.prompt: They keep checking their phone while you are telling a story.
They text to make sure you arrived home safely after a date.
They keep weekend plans vague until the last possible minute.
They are excited to introduce you to close friends early on.
They cancel a date at the last minute without offering a reason or a new time.
They ask before posting a photo of the two of you online.
They remember a small detail you mentioned weeks ago.
They expect a reply within a few minutes whenever they message.
They speak respectfully about former partners even when the relationships ended badly.
They make you the punchline of a joke in front of friends.
They regularly make time for friendships that do not include you.
They apologize after an argument and change the behavior that caused it.
They want to spend nearly all of their free time together.
They discuss the budget before suggesting an expensive trip together.
They ask for your phone password as proof that you trust them.
They say clearly when they need an evening alone to recharge.
They rarely ask a follow-up question when you share something important.
They celebrate your good news without comparing it to their own achievements.
They talk about moving in together during the first few dates.
They check in after a disagreement instead of pretending nothing happened.
They keep teasing you about something after you ask them to stop.
They are comfortable saying they do not know the answer.
They decide the whole weekend plan without asking what you want to do.
They notice you seem overwhelmed and ask whether you want help, listening, or space.
They flirt with someone else to see whether you get jealous.
They respect that you enjoy hobbies they do not personally understand.
They read a message over your shoulder without asking.
They suggest a date idea and ask what would make it enjoyable for you too.
They take responsibility for being late instead of blaming traffic every time.
They bring up old mistakes to keep score during every new disagreement.
